skill_name: Write a short essay explaining why physical education is important in schools.
workflow: Physical education is an important part of a student's learning experience. Not only does physical education provide students with the skills and knowledge to practice healthy activities and habits, but it also helps to build self-discipline, improve physical and mental health, increase cognitive ability, and promote social development.
